_comment: credit_usd = money per credit for credit-based seats (Codex Business/Team); cost there = credits used × credit_usd. Subscription plans as the vendors report them (Claude: organization.rate_limit_tier; Codex: plan_type). Prices per month; the Mac's currency is used when listed, else USD converted at the daily rate. Copied to ~/Library/Application Support/Codenotch/costs/plans.json on first run: edit that file, or point Settings → Costs at a remote catalog URL.
